blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Commercial and industrial land for sale in South Surrey: lots and development sites listed on the MLS® as commercial land. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.
What sold: commercial land in Surrey

In the second quarter of 2026, 15 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were land properties, against 56 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only South Surrey.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Smallest new lot by zone, City of Surrey and White Rock

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside South Surrey. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: Does this page include commercial land for lease?
faq.a: No, only property for sale. For lease listings, call or text Jared at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: How many commercial land properties sold in Surrey recently?
faq.a: 15 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey (GVR Commercial Edge).
